explainer_content.short_definition: 2010s pop where era-building, persona design, and album architecture are part of the musical signal.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Taylor Swift, Lorde, Beyonce, and peers made pop feel like a sequence of authored worlds rather than only a run of singles.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains how fan culture, visual framing, songwriting voice, and streaming-era albums fused into one interpretive surface.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The hook is still central, but the surrounding persona system changes how the listener hears the record.
